title: Account of a Tic Tac-type craft over Pennsylvania in 1967

tellings.quote: In the book we're going to give you, there's a a very good account of it from 1967 over Pennsylvania,

tellings.difference: Names the book as Disclosure: An Illustrated History, and does not mention the Tic Tac shape.
tellings.link_reason: Both are the 1967 Pennsylvania account in the book Greer is giving away.

plain: In 1967 a craft like the Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint and made famous by later Navy sightings, was seen over Pennsylvania, the guest Steven Greer tells Michels. He says a "very good account of it" is in a book he is handing Michels, Disclosure: An Illustrated History, a 2025 briefing document of his Disclosure Project, though when he names the book he does not mention the shape. If so, the Tic Tac shape was being seen decades before the Navy pilots reported it.
